steps.text: 'Dispatch speaking.'
'Target acquired. They're moving toward Lake Neva.'
'Cease fire and surround the target coordinates.'
'Coordinates sent to your terminals.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you out of the woods, Raidian?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Scout team here. We're at the rendezvous point.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The first batch of vehicles are here. We'll need to wait for the second batch to arrive.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Sorry, I didn't expect things to get so urgent.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Have you tracked more of the Armies' movements, Raidian?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Not yet... the military channel went dark after our broadcast. They're on guard now, and we're unable to get more information.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: It's so quiet, it's making me uneasy...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Stay hidden, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll be careful.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Stay in touch. How's Mantra?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Still exhausted. Vetochki and the others have made a stretcher for her—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mantra! You shouldn't be 'talking'!

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I'm awake. Tell Elysium that I can walk on my own.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, not yet.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: See? I told you so!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Remember how Blaze was bedridden for two weeks after getting injured on a mission? We didn't let her feet touch the ground for a single second.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: So don't even think about it, dear Mantra.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: ...The situation is different.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Okay, here's a compromise. Once you're through the woods, you can choose me or Elysium to be your crutch.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Is G-Grypherburg, on the other side, of the frozen lake?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I heard, the Infected, can't enter n-nomadic cities.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: I never went to the cities before I got infected. I lived all my life in the villages, until a Catastrophe infected most of us.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: But they said we didn't need to walk, right? There'll be vehicles, like the ones we found.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: I think Nikto was from Grypherburg. Too bad he isn't here.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Say, what do you think Nikto and Rankin are doing, Vetochki? Could they have already made it to that village they were talking about?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: M-Maybe.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I hope so.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Everyone, take cover, now!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: An explosion—from the forest? Is the Army here?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I just sensed it... Another army's attacking from the east.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: They know where we are. They're trying to force us in the direction of Lake Neva.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: They're out of their minds! We're already in the Central Governorate. The Armies must know what that means!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: 'Deity Grypherburg is under threat... the Army... will eliminate the enemy.'

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: It's a public broadcast. They're telling Grypherburg that they're putting down a rebellion!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I see... this was their plan all along...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: All this killing and herding... they're planning to reach the capital under the pretext of putting down a rebellion, and negotiate with the State Council by pointing their guns at the gates of Deity Grypherburg!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: This was what they're trying to achieve... by sacrificing hundreds of thousands in the Far North.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Can you hear me, Amiya?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: There are Army units to your east—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: ...The magnetic storms are interfering with comms. I can't get a good signal at this range.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The rest of the group will arrive soon. Eloysius, I need you here to get them on the vehicles and evacuate in an orderly manner.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I must go back and point the way for them.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You're leaving me here with these vehicles? Aren't you worried that I would abandon you and flee to Grypherburg?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: If that's your decision, I would appreciate a heads-up.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Rhodes Island will find a way.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Hah... is this 'Rhodes Island' full of people like you?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: No. They're much braver than I.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Your command, Sergeant.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: What the hell is that thing behind us? It appeared out of nowhere—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: (Stumbles)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The Army is shelling indiscriminately. Should we find another path?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can you reach Raidian, Elysium? The scout team might be in even more danger than we are!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Amiya! Where are you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're still in the forest on the eastern shores of Lake Neva! We're being fired upon by the Army—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: They have reinforcements coming from the east. We must get through the lake as quickly as possible! Grypherburg is on the other side.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The Armies cannot set foot on the western shore of Lake Neva without permission. That's our only chance.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We need to clear Lake Neva before the Armies complete their encirclement—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Raidian? Raidian?!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Magnetic storm—communications—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: —southwest—ice—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No lights, everyone. We'll have to cross the lake in darkness.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Go southwest... I'll point the way.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I understand. The stars, show the way—
Cannon shells fall like thunder, exploding in the middle of the crowd. The shockwave and shrapnel split the procession in two.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Dyadya Volya!
A crack appears in the ice, and some people have fallen into it.

steps.name: Panicked Miner
steps.text: Aaagh!!

steps.name: Panicked Miner
steps.text: The ice is still cracking—we can't get through!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Go back! Now! Don't come this way!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: They're getting closer!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can you reach Raidian?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We got separated. We have some straggling miners we need to pick up, to the northwest of where the shells fell—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: On my way.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: Argh—ugh...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Darya, your leg, it's bleeding... I'll wrap it up!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I'll help—

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: ...No, Vetochki. Leave me here.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: I have flint and kindling. Give me a torch and go. I'll buy you what time I can.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I'll carry you, Darya!

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Don't... don't give up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, don't give up! The bleeding will stop soon. You can get further treatment once we're on the vehicles—

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: But those bastards won't wait! They're herding us like wild manglers. Don't you see?

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: If they just wanted to kill us, they could have burned every inch that we passed through, blown every building up.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: Do you think they couldn't do it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's no reason to give up...

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: You don't understand. I was a hunter before they threw me into the mines. I know what some of the cityfolk like to do on hunting trips.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: They corral their game in one place, kill a couple, and watch the rest struggle.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: Honestly, I don't know how much time I can buy, but I have to try.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: It's just a hole in my leg. I'll crawl if I can't walk. I can get a few dozen meters to the east.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: Stop wasting time. Leave the torch and go.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Anxious Operator
steps.text: One by one, one by one! We'll be here for fifteen minutes, there's no need to—

steps.name: Anxious Operator
steps.text: —push...
The operator falls quiet. No one is pushing, no one is squeezing.
They just keep walking forward silently.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...I've never seen an evacuation so orderly.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Not even the famously disciplined First Army could do this.

steps.name: Anxious Operator
steps.text: That's a good thing, right?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: It's not normal, is it? It's as though they don't have survival instincts.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Alright. Maybe I'm overthinking it.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: And you, aren't you worried about your captain in the rear?

steps.name: Anxious Operator
steps.text: Our captain is the most experienced of us by far.
The operator stands on tiptoes, trying to see past the end of the procession that is indistinguishable from the pitch-black ice, looking for her captain.
All she sees is the bright red in the distance.

steps.name: Anxious Operator
steps.text: Did they really stop there...?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The enemy is shelling the ice!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I couldn't reach the driver. Someone needs to tell her to keep the vehicle running and be ready to roll at a moment's notice.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Do you read me?!

steps.name: Anxious Operator
steps.text: R-Roger!

steps.name: Anxious Operator
steps.text: You should get on, Eloysius. I'll take care of things here—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No, you go first and talk to the driver. For your captain.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'm staying here.
It was a torch that distracted the Army.
It began with a single torch that someone at the end of the procession raised.
No one heard if he said anything. No one asked why he did it. He simply stopped, lit his torch, and began to walk in the opposite direction.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Who lit the torch? I thought they said no lights—

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: It's Kian.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Kian? The one who made flint for everyone? I saw he gave some firewood to Darya just now.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: It's him. He's walking back. But that's where all the soldiers are! Is he trying to get himself killed?

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: He's doing the same thing that Darya is doing.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: But we're so close to safety—

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: I have a flint too, and some firewood.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: They're shelling the ice. They won't let us go. If we don't do something...

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: We all die.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: But I want to live! I want to go to Grypherburg!

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: We would have died in the mines, remember? Like all other Infected in Ursus.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: But if we can help the folks on the front lines survive, and the young ones who came to our aid...

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: People will remember what happened here long after we old-timers are gone.
One torch passes its flame to another.
One miner forsakes his life, then a second, and a third...
One by one, the miners who have not yet boarded the vehicles raise their torches and walk in the opposite direction.
Towards Kian, towards Darya, towards the trail of footsteps that led here, and towards the impending threat.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Th-They can't... bury us.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Not anymore.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: You're right. They can't bury us quietly anymore, not in the snow, in the mines, or in the lakes!

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: We'll take the torch from our brothers and sisters, and we'll light the way...

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: We'll make sure that all of Ursus sees—

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: And knows that we once lived.
The miners who chose to stay behind raise their torches high in the cold night.
They form a bright belt of fire on the ice, one that the gunners cannot miss.
'Ursus will not bury this night the way it has buried many others,' they firmly believe.
The red eyes gaze upon the firelight.
The guns continue to fire, and the ice continues to crack, sending more miners into the gaping crevasses.
They shout and keep their torches high to the very end, with only a slight trembling in their voices.
Of course they are afraid. Of course they are fearful.
But they keep their torches raised, trading their lives for the lives of those behind them.
The Rhodes Island personnel try to stop them, but no one listens.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: They're still firing, Amiya! Eloysius's vehicles are full, and the next batch hasn't arrived yet—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why... why are they doing this?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to stop them. We can't let—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I can't stop this many in my current state.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: But there must be something we can do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mantra...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can feel it. I can feel their...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Their... anger.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's so powerful. It's like it's burning them to ashes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I won't let them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This slaughter has to stop!
Anger. The same anger.
An emotion that Amiya has always fought to suppress, one that she would never allow to run unchecked.
Anger lights up her eyes, ignites her heart, and flows to her fingertips.

a.text: 'Even if I don't take revenge, even if I never hold a grudge, I still have the right to rage on forever!'

steps.text: The cerulean and black sword of wrath once again appears in her hand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ying Xiao—
A clean swing. Blue fire bursts from the tip of the sword, the highly concentrated energy drawing a wall of fire on the ice in the blink of an eye—another long and clear boundary.
On one side, the cracking ice and the shells repelled by the wall of fire.
On the other, the little Cautus and the torch-bearing Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You...
Amiya points her sword at the shore, at the Army that has herded and slaughtered people like livestock.
Blue fire rages at her sword-tip, a warning to the murderers, be it the guns, the soldiers, or the battleships. Until the flames cease, until the score is settled—
None shall pass.
'Sir, high-powered Originium signal, twelve o'clock, source unknown!'
'Slow down and observe.'
'Yes, sir.'

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...Did they cease fire?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: No, they just slowed down.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: You've stopped some of their attacks, Amiya. Rendezvous ASAP.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The other vehicles will arrive soon! Let's get out of here!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm staying until everyone is out.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wait... something's coming!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: A vehicle's coming toward us at high speed from the west, but it's not one of ours—I think it's a truck!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: They drove onto the ice!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: On alert—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Raidian! Finally got this thing to work. It's us! Me, Doctor, Ksenia—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! Mon3tr! How did you—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And, Operator Crownslayer...?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Didn't have time to chat along the way. I have a lot of questions myself.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: But get on first.

options: We owe the Truckers' Union one.
I'll tell you about it later.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Won't disappoint you.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We'll catch up later. For now, we need to get out of here.
After scanning the survivors on the ice, the lights of the outpost on the southwest shore of Lake Neva point to the Army on the opposite shore.
White light faces off against red light, and the shelling grows even sparser.
'All units, this is Dispatch.'
'All units, cease fire immediately. We have an urgent request from Deity Grypherburg.'
'Repeat, all units, cease fire immediately.'
'Please acknowledge.'
'Yes, sir.'

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Looks like it's stopped... for real this time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And everyone's here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank goodness...
